environmentVariables.name: HOMECASTR_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Homecastr API key. Use 'hc_demo_public_readonly' for free demo access (rate-limited). Get a full key at homecastr.com.

environmentVariables.name: HOMECASTR_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the Homecastr API. Defaults to https://www.homecastr.com - only override for self-hosted or staging environments.

environmentVariables.name: WORLDCASTR_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Worldcastr alias for the same API credential. HOMECASTR_API_KEY takes precedence when both are set.
